shortDescription: Module for setup of AuthProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client cert settings. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: http
options.description: Http user authentication params. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: jwt_profile_ref
options.description: Jwtserverprofile to be used for authentication. It is a reference to an object of type jwtserverprofile. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ldap
options.description: Ldap server and directory settings. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the auth profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: oauth_profile
options.description: Oauth profile - common endpoint information. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: saml
options.description: Saml settings. Field introduced in 17.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tacacs_plus
options.description: Tacacs+ settings. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the auth profile. Enum options - AUTH_PROFILE_LDAP, AUTH_PROFILE_TACACS_PLUS, AUTH_PROFILE_SAML, AUTH_PROFILE_PINGACCESS, AUTH_PROFILE_JWT, AUTH_PROFILE_OAUTH, AUTH_PROFILE_CLIENT_CERT. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- auth_profile_ldap,auth_profile_tacacs_plus,auth_profile_saml,auth_profile_jwt,auth_profile_oauth,auth_profile_client_cert), basic (allowed values- auth_profile_ldap,auth_profile_tacacs_plus

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the auth profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
